zh.title: 星宇航空與美國航空啟動代碼共享 覆蓋20北美城市
zh.summary: 星宇航空與美國航空啟動代碼共享；9/23售票、9/30首航、覆蓋20北美城市
body: 星宇航空與美國航空於2026年9月23日宣佈建立代碼共享合作夥伴關係，機票自同日開放銷售，航班將於9月30日正式首航。
合作涵蓋20個熱門北美城市，旅客可憑單一機票完成全程行程，並享受行李直掛至最終目的地的便利。
雙方並規劃未來推出雙向常旅客計畫，會員將可在代碼共享航班上累積里程，提升里程兌換靈活度。
美國航空確認此項合作將連接北美與臺北（TPE），進一步擴大跨太平洋航線選擇。
此次代碼共享為雙方在跨太平洋市場的重要佈局，預期將增強雙邊航點網絡與旅客轉機體驗。

en.title: STARLUX Airlines and American Airlines launch codeshare covering 20 North American destinations
en.summary: STARLUX and American Airlines launch codeshare; tickets 23 Sep, flights 30 Sep, 20 North American cities
body: STARLUX Airlines and American Airlines announced a codeshare partnership on 23 September 2026, with tickets available from that date and flights commencing on 30 September 2026.
The agreement covers 20 popular North American cities, allowing passengers to travel on a single ticket and have checked baggage transferred directly to the final destination.
Both carriers plan to introduce reciprocal loyalty benefits, enabling frequent‑flyer members to earn miles on codeshare flights in the future.
American Airlines confirmed the partnership connects North America with Taipei (TPE), expanding trans‑Pacific flight options.
The codeshare represents a significant step in the carriers’ trans‑Pacific strategy, strengthening network connectivity and improving the passenger transfer experience.

facts.claim: STARLUX Airlines and American Airlines announced a codeshare partnership with tickets available from 23 September 2026 and flights launching on 30 September 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: with tickets available starting September 23, 2026, and flights officially launching on September 30, 2026!

The partnership offers single‑ticket convenience and through‑checked baggage.
facts.sourceQuote: Single Ticket Convenience: Issue a single ticket for your entire itinerary, ensuring a seamless and worry-free transfer experience. Baggage Through-Checked: Checked baggage is sent straight through to your final destination, saving you from reclaiming and re-checking bags during transit (subject to local customs regulations).

facts.claim: Reciprocal loyalty benefits are planned, allowing members of both airlines to earn miles on codeshare flights.
facts.sourceQuote: Reciprocal Loyalty Benefits (Coming Soon): In the future, loyalty members from both airlines will be able to earn miles on codeshare flights, greatly enhancing mileage flexibility and options.
